# Hacker News Summary

> Hacker News article summaries based on extracted source text, with images from the original articles, refreshed every 20 minutes.

A scoring algorithm identifies and extracts the main text of linked web pages, then an AI model summarizes the extracted text. Images are selected from the original pages.

Each story links to the original article and its Hacker News discussion, with points, comment count and a short summary of the article content.

## Pages

- [Front page](https://hackernews.betacat.io/): current Hacker News front page with a summary for each story
- [Chinese front page](https://hackernews.betacat.io/zh): Chinese translations of article titles and summaries
- [Sitemap](https://hackernews.betacat.io/sitemap.xml): front pages and daily archives of top stories for each UTC day, at `/daily/YYYY-MM-DD/`
- [Atom feed](https://hackernews.betacat.io/feed.xml): latest stories with summaries

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/polyrabbit/hacker-news-digest)
